Sub: Intimation of Earnings Conference Call for discussion on Q1 FY27 Financial Results and 
Business Update 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, we hereby inform you that an Earnings Conference Call has been organized on 
Wednesday, 12th August 2026, at 11:00 A.M. (IST), post declaration of Unaudited Standalone and 
Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June 2026. The details of the 
Earnings Conference Call is enclosed herewith.  
 
Please note that the schedule of the aforesaid Earnings Call is subject to change. The changes might 
happen due to exigencies on the part of the Company/ Investor(s)/ Analyst(s). The above information 
shall also be disclosed on the website of the Company 
 
This is for your information and records.
